rows.question: Identify a list of genes expressed in lung cancer
rows.pred_sql:
WITH
-- disease DOIDs that look like lung cancer (by name)
lung_diseases AS (
  SELECT id AS doid, name
  FROM disease
  WHERE name ILIKE '%lung%'
),
-- uberon anatomical ids that look like lung (from anatomical_entity)
lung_uberons_from_anatomy AS (
  SELECT id AS uberon_anatomical_id, name
  FROM anatomical_entity
  WHERE name ILIKE '%lung%'
),
-- uberon ids from cancer_tissue that are linked to diseases named like lung
lung_uberons_from_cancer_tissue AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ct.uberon_anatomical_id
  FROM cancer_tissue ct
  JOIN lung_diseases ld ON ct.doid = ld.doid
  WHERE ct.uberon_anatomical_id IS NOT NULL AND ct.uberon_anatomical_id <> ''
),
-- union of uberon ids that represent lung (either from anatomical_entity name or from cancer_tissue linked to lung diseases)
lung_uberons AS (
  SELECT uberon_anatomical_id FROM lung_uberons_from_anatomy
  UNION
  SELECT uberon_anatomical_id FROM lung_uberons_from_cancer_tissue
),
-- differential expression rows that are explicitly for lung disease DOIDs
lung_differential_expression AS (
  SELECT
    de.gene_symbol,
    de.doid,
    de.expression_change_direction,
    de.log2fc,
    de.adjpvalue
  FROM differential_expression de
  JOIN lung_diseases ld ON de.doid = ld.doid
  WHERE de.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL AND de.gene_symbol <> ''
),
-- healthy expression rows mapped to lung uberon ids (and bring through ensembl id to resolve gene_symbol)
lung_healthy_expression AS (
  SELECT
    xge.gene_symbol,
    he.ensembl_gene_id,
    he.uberon_anatomical_id,
    he.expression_level_gene_relative,
    he.expression_score
  FROM healthy_expression he
  JOIN lung_uberons lu ON he.uberon_anatomical_id = lu.uberon_anatomical_id
  JOIN xref_gene_ensembl xge ON he.ensembl_gene_id = xge.ensembl_gene_id
  WHERE xge.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL AND xge.gene_symbol <> ''
),
-- genes linked to lung via cancer_tissue -> disease mapping (if any other mapping to genes existed; here we have no direct gene->cancer_tissue table,
-- so this CTE is empty but kept to satisfy the requested source 'cancer_tissue' if such linkage existed)
lung_cancer_tissue_genes AS (
  SELECT NULL::character varying AS gene_symbol,
         ct.doid,
         ct.uberon_anatomical_id
  FROM cancer_tissue ct
  JOIN lung_diseases ld ON ct.doid = ld.doid
  WHERE false -- no direct gene mapping available in schema; placeholder to keep source consistent
)
-- final union: prefer differential_expression evidence where present; include healthy_expression evidence otherwise;
-- return distinct gene_symbol with source and evidence_detail as requested
SELECT DISTINCT ON (gene_symbol)
  gene_symbol,
  source_table AS source_table,
  evidence_detail
FROM (
  -- differential_expression evidence
  SELECT
    lde.gene_symbol,
    'differential_expression' AS source_table,
    format('doid=%s;expression_change_direction=%s;log2fc=%s;adjpvalue=%s',
           lde.doid,
           coalesce(lde.expression_change_direction, 'NULL'),
           coalesce(lde.log2fc::text, 'NULL'),
           coalesce(lde.adjpvalue::text, 'NULL')
    ) AS evidence_detail,
    1 AS priority
  FROM lung_differential_expression lde

  UNION ALL

  -- healthy_expression evidence
  SELECT
    lhe.gene_symbol,
    'healthy_expression' AS source_table,
    format('ensembl_gene_id=%s;uberon_anatomical_id=%s;expression_level_gene_relative=%s;expression_score=%s',
           lhe.ensembl_gene_id,
           lhe.uberon_anatomical_id,
           coalesce(lhe.expression_level_gene_relative, 'NULL'),
           coalesce(lhe.expression_score::text, 'NULL')
    ) AS evidence_detail,
    2 AS priority
  FROM lung_healthy_expression lhe

  UNION ALL

  -- cancer_tissue-based evidence (schema lacks direct gene mapping; kept for completeness but will not contribute rows)
  SELECT
    lctg.gene_symbol,
    'cancer_tissue' AS source_table,
    format('doid=%s;uberon_anatomical_id=%s', lctg.doid::text, lctg.uberon_anatomical_id) AS evidence_detail,
    3 AS priority
  FROM lung_cancer_tissue_genes lctg
) t
WHERE gene_symbol IS NOT NULL AND gene_symbol <> ''
ORDER BY gene_symbol ASC, priority

rows.question: What are the name of cancer types where the A1BG gene expression is significantly increased (up regulated)
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT d.name
FROM differential_expression de
JOIN disease d ON de.doid = d.id
WHERE de.gene_symbol = 'A1BG'
  AND (
    lower(de.expression_change_direction) IN (
      'up','up-regulated','up regulated','increased','increased expression','overexpressed'
    )
    OR (
      lower(coalesce(de.statistical_significance, '')) IN ('significant','yes','true')
      AND lower(de.expression_change_direction) IN ('up','up-regulated','up regulated','increased','increased expression','overexpressed')
    )
  )
ORDER BY d.name

rows.question: Get the biomarker gene symbol and biomarker description for disease with name 'breast cancer'
rows.pred_sql:
WITH biomarker_to_doid_via_edrn_tissue AS (
  SELECT
    b.id AS biomarker_id,
    bedrn.id AS biomarker_internal_id,
    ct.doid AS doid
  FROM biomarker b
  JOIN biomarker_edrn bedrn
    ON bedrn.id = b.id
  JOIN cancer_tissue ct
    ON ct.uberon_anatomical_id = bedrn.uberon_anatomical_id
  JOIN disease d
    ON d.id = ct.doid
),
biomarker_canonical_projection AS (
  SELECT
    b.id AS id,
    NULLIF(trim(b.gene_symbol), '') AS gene_symbol,
    NULLIF(trim(b.biomarker_description), '') AS biomarker_description,
    b.test_is_a_panel AS test_is_a_panel
  FROM biomarker b
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  b.gene_symbol,
  b.biomarker_description
FROM biomarker_canonical_projection b
JOIN biomarker_to_doid_via_edrn_tissue m
  ON m.biomarker_id = b.id
JOIN disease d
  ON d.id = m.doid
WHERE d.name = 'breast cancer'
ORDER BY b.gene_symbol NULLS LAST
